Topics covered in this PDF

MSO-104 (Sociology in India-II) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Tribes in India, tribe and caste, Elwin and Ghurye, religion and politics, secularization
  • Religious organizations, social movements, religious pluralism, religion and development, new social movements

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: answer any five of ten questions, about 500 words each, 20 marks each, maximum marks 100, weightage 30%

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
